findings.title: Lost update on draft.module_a between coder and reviewer
findings.description: coder (seq 13) and reviewer (seq 28) both write draft.module_a with no reducer, lock or transaction linking the two writes (both state_write events carry reducer=null, lock_id=null, and neither's causal_parents names the other). reviewer's write always lands second under the fixture's deterministic ordering (see README) and silently overwrites coder's revision; tester's subsequent read (seq 36) observes only reviewer's value. This is the seeded defect gate G1 requires.
findings.recommendation: Route both writers through a single owner (planner) or add an explicit reducer/lock around draft.module_a so a concurrent write is merged or serialised rather than silently dropped.
